# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our standard

Be respectful, technically specific, and constructive. Critique evidence, code, or claims rather than people. Harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing, and deliberately disruptive behavior are not acceptable.

## Project context

This project publishes reproducibility and failure evidence. Disagreement about benchmark interpretation is welcome when supported by concrete files, commands, logs, or measurements. Do not pressure contributors to hide negative results or overstate model capabilities.

## Privacy and safety

Do not post credentials, private contact information, private datasets, or recordings of people who did not consent to publication. This project's voice tests use synthetic references rather than real-person voice cloning.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove contributions that violate these standards and may restrict participation when necessary to protect the project and its contributors.

## Reporting

For sensitive security matters, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). For ordinary project questions, use the support channels described in [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md).
